newsitem.title: JORDAN: Bank of Jordan proposes capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Jordan proposes capital increase.

text.p: Bank of Jordan Chairman Tawfiq al-Fakhouri was quoted on Thursday as saying the bank would propose doubling its capital to 21 million dinars to meet Central Bank minimum capital requirements.

Fakhouri said in remarks carried by Jordanian newspapers that half the money would be transferred from reserves and retained profits, with current shareholders receiving bonus shares for every two existing shares they hold.
The remaining 5.25 million dinars would be raised through an subscription, he said.
The bank would call an extraordinary meeting of shareholders in two weeks to discuss the proposals, he added.

But Fakhouri said frequently discussed plans for a merger with Jordan Kuwait Bank, shelved and then revived last month, had been stymied once again after Kuwaiti shareholders in Jordan Kuwait Bank reversed a decision taken in March to support the merger.
Bank of Jordan posted 1996 net profits of 5.07 million dinars against 2.99 million dinars in 1995. Its assets stood at 534 million dinars against 457 million in 1995.
